items.name: consent-provider
items.title: Consent provider
items.description: ConsentProvider and useConsent hook. Necessary, analytics and marketing categories, versioned consent, safe localStorage persistence and an onChange callback to record consent server-side. POPIA s11, s69, s18.

items.name: consent-banner
items.title: Consent banner
items.description: Cookie and tracker banner with equally prominent Accept all and Reject all, plus a Choose dialog with per-category switches. No dark patterns. POPIA s69, s18.

items.name: consent-gate
items.title: Consent gate
items.description: ConsentGate renders children or loads scripts only after consent. Includes loadScript and Google Consent Mode v2 helpers with denied defaults. POPIA s69.

items.name: consent-system
items.title: Consent system
items.description: Everything for cookie and tracker consent in one install: provider, banner, gate and consent record helpers. POPIA s11, s18, s69.

items.name: consent-record
items.title: Consent record helpers
items.description: Types and helpers to build consent event payloads with exact wording and a SHA-256 wording hash. POPIA s11(2)(a) burden of proof.

items.name: sa-id
items.title: SA ID helpers
items.description: isValidSaId, parseSaId and maskSaId for South African ID numbers. Luhn and date validation. POPIA s19, s57.

items.name: redact
items.title: Redact for logging
items.description: Redact emails, SA ID numbers, SA phone numbers, card and account numbers and tokens from strings and objects before logging. POPIA s19, s14.

items.name: marketing-opt-in
items.title: Marketing opt-in (Form 4 style)
items.description: Direct marketing opt-in substantially similar to Form 4. Unticked box per channel, business identity, what is marketed, how to withdraw. Emits a consent record with wording and hash. POPIA s69, Reg 6.

items.name: collection-notice
items.title: Collection notice
items.description: Short notice at the point of collection with a link to the full privacy notice. POPIA s18.

items.name: sa-id-input
items.title: SA ID input
items.description: SA ID number input with Luhn and date validation, masked display after blur and a why-we-need-it helper. Never logs the value. POPIA s10, s18, s19.

items.name: privacy-centre
items.title: Privacy centre
items.description: Account settings panel: download my data, delete my account, marketing preferences, withdraw consent, object (Form 1) and complain to the Information Regulator. POPIA s23, s24, s11(3), s69, s74.

items.name: supabase-privacy-schema
items.title: Supabase privacy schema
items.description: Migrations for schema privacy: data inventory, append-only consent events, DSAR requests, retention runs, access audit, retention job and a security self-check. RLS forced everywhere. POPIA s11, s14, s17, s19, s23, s24.

items.name: supabase-privacy-functions
items.title: Supabase privacy edge functions
items.description: Deno edge functions for data export, account deletion, consent recording and one-click unsubscribe, with shared config. Identity from JWT only. POPIA s11(2), s19, s23, s24, s69(4).
